title: Predicting Customer Churn for a Telecom Company Using Random Forest
abstract: This study builds a random forest model that predicts customer churn from call and billing records. The system flags high-risk subscribers so retention teams can intervene early. Evaluation shows strong precision and identifies key churn drivers.
author: Sample Author

title: Mobile-Based Flood Early Warning System for River Communities
abstract: This thesis develops a mobile application that monitors river water levels using ultrasonic sensors and sends early warnings. The system publishes alerts through the app and SMS. Field tests during the rainy season show reliable triggers.
author: Sample Author

title: Sentiment Analysis of Food Review Websites Using Naive Bayes
abstract: This research classifies online food reviews into positive and negative opinions using naive bayes. Text preprocessing and feature selection improve accuracy. The tool helps restaurant owners track customer satisfaction.
